name: Load 10 Moving Clients
description: QA-5 D35 (request §133-134): Docs/LoadTest.md's conditions as a scenario. Server:DevRespawn=true and MaxPlayers 100 like the load test (no match flow; nobody dies), Qa:Events=false so the QA tick diff adds no cost the load test did not have. 10 headless clients join and walk (each its own direction) for 60 s while sending input every tick. tickP95 over that minute must stay under ${tickP95LimitMs} ms: a deliberately loose smoke threshold, the real target is the user's to set from the baseline (§134; LoadTest.md measured p95 0.1-0.3 ms for 50 bots). The 60 s tick p95/p99 and memory are saved and recorded in the run history (QA/Reports/history), so a second run shows the Baseline table.
